Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human colorectal carcinoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HCT116 cells, a human colorectal carcinoma-derived epithelial cell line used as a model of colorectal cancer and transcriptional regulation.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from a population of cultured cells: intact nuclei are isolated, permeabilized, and incubated with Tn5 transposase to tag accessible chromatin before PCR amplification and sequencing.
